description: Golden cases of the policy file `log-policy.json` (docs/spec/logging.md#policy-file). `valid` texts are accepted and give `classes`; `allows` and `refuses` are the (class, level) pairs that the policy stores and does not store. `default` is the default policy, which every writer and the native ring apply before the first policy and while no policy file exists. `invalid` texts are refused with `error`, in which `<file>` is the name the reader was given; a case with `error_prefix` is refused with an error that starts with it, because the text after it is the message of the JSON parser of the language.

valid.name: each class stores up to its own level
off stores no level of the class and error stores only errors
white space between the tokens is allowed

invalid.name: a member other than schema and classes
invalid.error: <file>: the member extra is not one of schema, classes

invalid.name: the first of several unknown members, in name order
invalid.error: <file>: the member alpha is not one of schema, classes

invalid.name: a missing schema
invalid.error: <file>: schema must be the number 1, found

invalid.name: a schema that is text
invalid.error: <file>: schema must be the number 1, found "1"

invalid.name: a schema that is not an integer
invalid.error: <file>: schema must be the number 1, found 1.5

invalid.name: missing classes
invalid.error: <file>: classes must be an object that names every class

invalid.name: classes that is null
invalid.error: <file>: classes must be an object that names every class

invalid.name: classes that is a list
invalid.error: <file>: classes must be an object that names every class

invalid.name: a class outside the contract
invalid.error: <file>: the class audio is not one of lifecycle, input, call, io, frame

invalid.name: the first missing class, in the order of the contract
a level that is not text
invalid.error: <file>: the level of the class lifecycle must be text, found 3

invalid.name: a level that is null
invalid.error: <file>: the level of the class input must be text, found null

invalid.name: a level outside the six
invalid.error: <file>: the level "verbose" of the class call is not one of off, error, warn, info, debug, trace

invalid.name: a level in capital letters
invalid.error: <file>: the level "Info" of the class lifecycle is not one of off, error, warn, info, debug, trace

unchanged_by_watcher.name: an empty file is a file that is being written; the watcher waits for the next notification and reports nothing
a file of white space only is the same
